description: Search USDA agricultural statistics by commodity, statistic, geography, and year. Returns production, yield, acreage, prices, and livestock data (e.g., commodity="CORN", state="CALIFORNIA"). FARMLAND VALUE per acre is commodity="AG LAND" with stat_category="ASSET VALUE" and unit="$ / ACRE", for a county add agg_level="COUNTY", state and county (e.g. state="ILLINOIS", county="WOODFORD"); county values come from the Census of Agriculture (2022, 2017, 2012), the yearly survey is state and national.

county.description: County name without the word County, e.g., "WOODFORD" (optional; use with agg_level="COUNTY" and a state)

group.description: Commodity group, e.g., "FIELD CROPS", "FRUIT & TREE NUTS", "VEGETABLES" (optional)

source.description: Data source: "SURVEY" or "CENSUS" (optional, defaults to all)

stat_category.description: Statistic category, e.g., "YIELD", "PRODUCTION", "AREA PLANTED", "AREA HARVESTED", "PRICE RECEIVED", "INVENTORY"

unit.description: Unit of the statistic, e.g., "$ / ACRE" for farmland value per acre, "BU / ACRE" for yield (optional)

name: nass_query

data.description: Array of up to 200 agricultural records

truncated.description: True if results exceed 200 records and were truncated

title: Nass Query
